highlights.title: GPT-6 is in the model list
highlights.line: OpenAI agents can run GPT-6: it is in the model list, and Kosmos updates the Codex it runs so the newest ChatGPT models start.

highlights.title: Report or block someone outside your Kosmos
highlights.line: A shared-room message from someone outside your Kosmos offers Report and Block; Settings, Your Profile lists who you blocked.

highlights.title: Sort your Files
highlights.line: An agent's and a project's Files sort newest first, oldest first, A to Z or Z to A, and each screen keeps your choice.

highlights.title: Flip through every page of a PDF
highlights.line: Previewing a PDF with several pages lets you flip through all of them, not only the first.

highlights.title: Link previews show their picture
highlights.line: A link preview appears once, with its picture or with words only, never with an empty picture box.
